name: RC-B10-0508/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the political situation in Myanmar including the humanitarian crisis of the Rohingya
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for Myanmar's military leaders to give up power and restore the elected civilian government. It rejects the elections the military has planned for December 2025 and January 2026 as illegitimate. It asks for the release of political prisoners, including Aung San Suu Kyi, and for an end to attacks on civilians. It also calls for more aid for Rohingya refugees and for those responsible for atrocities to face justice. This is a statement of the Parliament's position, not a law.

- The Parliament urges the military to hand back power and rejects its planned elections.
- It asks for more humanitarian aid, especially for Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh.
- It calls for sanctions and justice, but the text itself changes nothing on the ground.
